entries.title: Psalms 2:1
segments: ¶Why do the nations rage, And the people plot a vain thing?

entries.title: Psalms 2:2
segments: The kings of the earth set themselves, And the rulers take counsel together, Against the LORD and against His Anointed, [saying],

entries.title: Psalms 2:3
segments: "Let us break Their bonds in pieces And cast away Their cords from us."

entries.title: Psalms 2:4
segments: He who sits in the heavens shall laugh; The Lord shall hold them in derision.

entries.title: Psalms 2:5
segments: Then He shall speak to them in His wrath, And distress them in His deep displeasure:

entries.title: Psalms 2:6
segments: "Yet I have set My King On My holy hill of Zion."

entries.title: Psalms 2:7
segments: ¶"I will declare the decree: The LORD has said to Me, 'You [are] My Son, Today I have begotten You.

entries.title: Psalms 2:8
segments: Ask of Me, and I will give [You] The nations [for] Your inheritance, And the ends of the earth [for] Your possession.

entries.title: Psalms 2:9
segments: You shall break them with a rod of iron; You shall dash them to pieces like a potter's vessel.'"

entries.title: Psalms 2:10
segments: ¶Now therefore, be wise, O kings; Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 2:11
segments: Serve the LORD with fear, And rejoice with trembling.

entries.title: Psalms 2:12
segments: Kiss the Son, lest He be angry, And you perish [in] the way, When His wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed [are] all those who put their trust in Him.
